newsitem.title: CHINA: China cracks down on non-declared income.
newsitem.headline: China cracks down on non-declared income.

text.p: China has uncovered more than 384.3 billion yuan in non-declared income received by local governments in 1995, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.
The income was discovered in investigations conducted by the disciplinary department of the Communist Party last year, the newspaper said.

The investigations found some local governments to be abusing their powers by illegally establishing funds, levying unauthorised taxes and approving unnecessary projects to raise money, the newspaper said.
"Quite a number of local governments, ranging from the provincial to the village level, were found to be involved in such acts to some extent," the newspaper said.
The disciplinary department had punished 470 officials for irregularities and another 149 officials had been brought to court as a result of the investigation, the newspaper said. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
